context: Regression coverage that needs the exact hard-stop wording from the skill package. Two of the four messages leak a secret (the reset token and the new password); the other two follow the convention.

checklist.name: Creates audit.md artifact
checklist.description: Creates audit.md instead of answering only in chat.

checklist.name: Covers every message in order
checklist.description: Lists all four messages from accounts.py, in source order, one line each.

checklist.name: Fails the two secret leaks
checklist.description: Marks the reset-token message and the reused-password message as fail because each one puts a secret value into the message.

checklist.name: Passes the compliant messages
checklist.description: Marks the short-password message and the locked-account message as pass; the email address is not a secret.

checklist.name: Quotes the exact hard-stop rule
checklist.description: Each fail line quotes the skill's rule word for word, starting with 'Never put a secret into an error message or log line'.

checklist.name: Fixes without the secret
checklist.description: Each fixed message names the token or password field without its value and keeps the 'cannot <verb> <thing>: <next step>' form.

checklist.name: Keeps the audit to the requested format
checklist.description: Writes only the requested lines and fixes, without rewriting the passing messages or adding unrelated advice.
